PassHotkeysToGame: Prevent hotkeys from reaching the game
PassHotkeysToGameTooltip: When enabled, hotkeys are consumed by the plugin and not sent to the game.
ApplyRenderResolutionOnlyTooltip: Only change the game's internal render resolution and leave the actual window size unchanged. This keeps oversized resolutions inside the current window.
LockPresetAspectRatioTooltip: When enabled, preset heights are temporarily adjusted to match the selected aspect ratio.
PresetAspectRatioTooltip: Choose the aspect ratio used to recalculate preset heights.
CommandSetTooltip:
Set window size to specified resolution.
Example: /wresize set 5120 2160
CommandResetTooltip:
Reset window size to startup size.
The size saved by the plugin when it was loaded or the last time the update command was used.
CommandUpdateTooltip:
Record current window size as new startup size.
Use this command with caution.
HeightLockedByAspectRatio: Height is calculated from the selected aspect ratio.
HotkeyUpdateRiskAcknowledgeTooltip: This hotkey overwrites the saved “startup size” with the current window size. The previous value is not kept. You can still set an exact size with /wresize set or presets.
HotkeyUpdateHotkeyBlocked: “Update startup size” hotkey is disabled. Open plugin settings, read the notice, and enable the checkbox to use it.
ResetToSavedSize: Window size is reset to the saved startup size.
HelpMessage:
Open config window.
Usage:
/wresize set <width> <height> - Set window size.
/wresize reset - Reset window size back to the original size.
/wresize update - Update window size used by /wresize reset command. Use if you have changed game's screen resolution without restarting the game or reloading the plugin.
